svg.title: Role Battle Day 02 combat identity mind map
svg.desc: A manually authored detailed mind map showing the change from raw actor tags to a replicated server-owned combat identity, its consumers, authority guards, validation, and future handoffs.
svg.text: Day 02 — replace actor-tag guesses with combat identity
2026-08-08 | server-owned data contract → replication → generic consumers → fail-closed validation
REPLICATED COMBAT IDENTITY
Every combat avatar states what it is and what it may do.
Clients observe; authority initializes and mutates.
DAY 02 COMPLETE
BEFORE
Combat meaning lived in raw actor tags
Player and Enemy tags drove IsNotFriend
AI acquisition had Player-specific fallback logic
Civilian had no explicit common identity contract
Risk: new roles could be misclassified, and clients had no
single replicated view of combat capabilities.
DATA CONTRACT
FAuraCombatIdentity = four tags + four flags
Faction • Control • Combat profile • Death policy
Targetable • Can attack • Can be damaged
Allow friendly fire
All categories must be valid. Flags are explicit; they are not
silently inferred from faction or profile.
DEFAULT IDENTITIES
Concrete, bounded Day 02 values
Player: Faction.Player / Control.Player
Enemy: Faction.Enemy / Control.EnemyAI
Civilian fixture: cannot attack; can be damaged
Player and Enemy: Combat.Unassigned transitionally
Death policies: PlayerRespawn, EnemyLoot, and
PopulationRespawn are carried as identity data.
OWNERSHIP AND REPLICATION
One component on the common character base
Authority resolves defaults after tag initialization
Component stores one replicated identity property
Clients receive all fields through OnRep_Identity
Generic FindComponentByClass lookup works for any actor;
consumers do not cast to a concrete character type.
MIGRATED CONSUMERS
Compatibility without new tag checks
IsNotFriend reads identity and a bounded truth table
Player ↔ Enemy permitted; same faction denied
Civilian, null, self, invalid identity denied
Enemy AI selects nearest valid targetable Player identity
Projectiles keep resolving identity through their source avatar.
AUTHORITY GUARD AND EVIDENCE
Clients cannot invent combat identity
✓ No client setter or identity RPC
✓ Invalid identity fails closed; diagnostics rate-limited
✓ 3/3 focused and 17/17 full native tests
✓ Day 01 regression and 22/22 graph smoke
✓ Server/client identity replication and AI targeting
Later two-client Listen and Dedicated reports also pass.
Downstream handoff
Days 05–06 must replace Combat.Unassigned with role-derived Combat.Magic or Combat.Gun before attributes and grants. Pickup eligibility remains a separate
compatibility concern for Day 20. Day 03 replaces the bounded IsNotFriend table with the full relationship and permission service.
CORE GUARANTEE
Authority writes; clients observe
Raw tags → explicit identity → server component → replicated state → generic lookup → tested compatibility
